name: recap-desktop
description: Recap — desktop recorder. Records native system audio + mic and uploads to your Recap account.
author: mrmoneycoach

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5174 && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && cross-env RECAP_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Recap captures your microphone alongside the other participants so the transcript covers both sides of the call.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Recap uses ScreenCaptureKit to capture system audio from your meeting tab or window.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Recap only records audio; the camera permission is requested by macOS as part of the screen-sharing API but no video is captured.
